title: Witness: Zaldy Co's alleged kickbacks have acknowledgment receipts

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The alleged kickbacks delivered to former Ako Bicol party-list Rep. Zaldy Co from former Public Works engineer Henry Alcantara have acknowledgment receipts (AR), a witness told the Sandiganbayan Third Division on Thursday. Wirt Walter Rosales, personal assistant of Alcantara, made this revelation when he testified before the anti-graft court during the bail hearing of former Speaker Martin Romualdez, who faces a plunder case stemming from alleged kickbacks from infrastructure projects worth P7.44 billion. Co, the former House appropriations committee chairperson during the speakership of Romualdez, was a co-accused in the case. READ: Alcantara: 20% kickback began in 2022, hiked during […]...
